rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something ordinary or suitable for normal use rather than special occasions.

example.english: This shirt is very ordinary and perfect for everyday wear.
example.traditional: 呢件衫好普通，平時着最啱。
example.jyutping: ne1 gin6 saam1 hou2 pou2 tung1 ping4 si4 zoek3 zeoi3 ngaam1

rows.note: Choose this when “everyday” means routine, daily-life, or not reserved for special occasions.

example.english: These are things I use for everyday work.
example.traditional: 呢啲係我日常返工用嘅嘢。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 hai6 ngo5 jat6 soeng4 faan1 gung1 jung6 ge3 je5

rows.note: Use this when everyday means occurring every single day, especially when stressing daily repetition.

example.english: I drink coffee everyday; if I don't, I have no energy.
example.traditional: 我日日都飲咖啡，唔飲就冇精神。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat6 jat6 dou1 jam2 gaa3 fe1 m4 jam2 zau6 mou5 zing1 san4
